sections.content: You know reported speech from B1 Unit 13 (*estilo indirecto*) and reported yes/no questions with *preguntó si* from A2 Unit 14 (*preguntas indirectas*). This lesson uses them for misunderstandings: report a statement with *decir que* or *explicar que*, and a yes/no question with *preguntar si*. When you report a present-tense sentence, the verb moves back one step, as in B1 Unit 13: *Estoy ocupada* becomes *Ana dijo que estaba ocupada*.

items.english: Ana said that she was busy.

items.spanish: Me explicó que no podía venir.
items.english: She explained to me that she could not come.
She asked me if I had time.

sections.content: Use *que* after decir and explicar, and si for reported yes/no questions.
